title: Does last year's plan still fit?

blocks.text: A rural cooperative replaces poles in batches. This year's rules are in `build(costs, values, must, budget)` in `carryover.py`: fund batches within the budget, fund every must-do batch, and maximize value. Before re-planning, the planners ask a simple question: does last year's plan (a set of batch names) still keep this year's rules?

items: `add_plan_hint(model, pick, plan)`: hint the plan to the model, one hint per batch.
`fits(costs, values, must, budget, plan)`: build the model, hint the plan, have CP-SAT fix every variable to its hint, solve with one worker, and return whether a solution exists.

blocks.text: The model, with $`P`$ the batches, $`c_p`$ their costs, $`v_p`$ their values and $`M`$ the must-dos:
The hint is $`\bar x_p = 1`$ if $`p`$ is in the plan, for every $`p \in P`$. Think about what the solver may do with a variable that has no hint at all. About ten lines.

cases.says: a plan within this year's budget fits, and one over it does not
with every variable fixed to its hint, the solver returns exactly the hinted plan
a plan that leaves out a must-do project does not fit
